notes.title: Warehouse Manager Simulator - Version 1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for the feedback and for the suggestions, here is what was added:

- Delivery truck save: the delivery truck now saves, so you can order 8 pallets, sleep, quit the game, and after you load the game, the truck will still come with the order.

- Office upgrades: now there are 2 upgrades for the office, just for design, upgrading the bed area and adding some props in the office. The first upgrade is a classic design style, and the second one is a modern design style.

- Warehouse Management System App (WMS App): now there is a new app on the computer where you can see what active pallets you have in the warehouse, in each area, and see the available space on the shelves, for normal and fragile shelves.

If you have any feedback or suggestions for the next update, feel free to share them on the "Bugs / Glitches / Suggestions" discussion thread!

Thank you for being a part of the community of this game!

notes.title: Update - Version 1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is the first update of Warehouse Manager Simulator.

- Increased forklift acceleration.
- Tweaked the forklift acceleration: forklift can now accelerate better when the wheels are turn to the max steering angle. 
- Increased day time.
- Increased forklift steer angle.
- Decreased the degradation of the forklift.
- Added colors to mails:
   - Request mails: Yellow
   - Urgent mails: Orange
   - Storage request mails: Purple
   - Thank You mails: Green
   - Wrong Order mails: Red
- Changed the forklift view: removed the 360 camera that was causing problems and added a driver's point of view camera.
- Changed the precision forklift camera: the precision camera can now be moved left and right, for a perfect angle when moving pallets.
